κεκοιμημένων φαινόμενος, ὅμοιος ἑώραται τῷ ὅτε τὴν σάρκα εἶχε σχήματι. Εἶτα·

pass_b_english: …and earthly body can be taken that way. Whenever someone among those who have fallen asleep is reported as appearing, he is seen in a form like the one he had while he still wore flesh.

Samuel too, when he appears and is plainly visible, shows that he was clothed with a body—especially if the proofs force us to say the soul's substance is incorporeal. So also the rich man under punishment, and the…
